dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: I've heard that Master's taken on quite a fair bit of work this Lantern Rite. It should be going smoothly, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Still, there's neither hide nor hair of him, as always...

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Oh, my apologies. How may the Feiyun Commerce Guild be of assistance to you, good sirs?
